mapper.update: WITH joined_tables AS ( SELECT com.id FROM gc_subject_complete com LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id = com.subject_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s2 ON s2.fid = s.id LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.sub_id = s2.id WHERE v.id = #{videoId} AND com.master_id = #{masterId} ) UPDATE gc_subject_complete SET subject_state = 2 FROM joined_tables WHERE gc_subject_complete.id = joined_tables.id
